title: Local TV ad cost: broadcast, cable and streaming

facts.fact: A local TV ad usually costs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand dollars per airing, according to 2026 guidance from Comcast Advertising and National Media Spots.
facts.value: a few hundred to several thousand dollars
facts.quote: A local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand per airing.

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists local broadcast TV at $500 to $10,000 per month.
facts.quote: Local broadcast TV | $500 to $10,000 | Per month

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists regional cable TV at $1,000 to $20,000 per month.
facts.quote: Regional cable TV | $1,000 to $20,000 | Per month

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists streaming/CTV at $500 to $50,000+ per month.
National Media Spots lists streaming/CTV at $15 to $40+ CPM.
Amazon Ads lists a 30-second TV spot at $5 to $30 CPM, a figure the page says is undated.
facts.quote: TV, 30-second spot | $5 to $30 | CPM | Amazon Ads | Date not stated

facts.fact: Per Moonb's 2026 commercial cost guide, citing NBC via Bloomberg, the average Super Bowl 30-second spot cost about $8 million in airtime, with some above $10 million.
facts.value: about $8 million average; some above $10 million
facts.quote: About $8 million average, some above $10 million

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts production for a simple local TV spot at $1,500 to $10,000.
facts.quote: Moonb’s 2026 guide puts a simple local spot at $1,500 to $10,000 for production.

facts.fact: The page states that professional mid-range TV commercial production runs $10,000 to $50,000.
National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.
facts.quote: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.

facts.fact: National Media Spots says prime time, typically 8 to 11 PM, carries the highest local TV rates.
facts.quote: Prime time (typically 8 to 11 PM) carries the highest rates because viewing peaks then.

facts.fact: Per Comcast Advertising, smaller DMAs generally cost less for local TV ads and major metropolitan areas cost more.
facts.quote: Smaller DMAs generally cost less and major metropolitan areas cost more, per Comcast Advertising.

facts.fact: BIA's September 2026 update puts 2026 local political spending at $9.7 billion, up from $8.4 billion in April.
facts.quote: The September update puts local political spending at $9.7 billion for 2026, up from $8.4 billion in April.

facts.fact: BIA says $1.2 billion of the $1.3 billion increase in local political spending went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).
facts.quote: Of that $1.3 billion increase, BIA says $1.2 billion went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).
